record.question: Which reviewed NPS features and explicit connectors complete the remaining Glacier Point Road routes, loops, junctions, and turnarounds?
record.reason: Sentinel Dome, Taft Point, and McGurk Meadow now have exact-endpoint route graphs. The combined loop, overlook, Mono Meadow, Dewey Point, Ostrander Lake, Panorama, and full Pohono connectors remain unresolved; nearby or unnamed lines are not joined without route-specific review.
